videos.title: Psychologist: The Woman He Dates Isn't The Woman He Marries | Sadia Khan
videos.description:
If similarity feels like settling, your standards might be the problem.

In this clip, psychologist Sadia Khan and Jay Shetty talk about why the people we keep ending up with aren't the ones we attract, but the ones we choose to entertain.

Sadia opens up about the clients she sees most, what getting ghosted really tells you, and why the "nice guy" is often the one who gets cheated on.

Learn about the three things a woman needs to truly fall in love, the three a man needs, and why unconditional love can quietly invite unconditional disrespect.

JAY'S DAILY WISDOM DELIVERED STRAIGHT TO YOUR INBOX
Join 900,000+ readers discovering how small daily shifts create big life change with my free newsletter. Subscribe https://news.jayshetty.me/subscribe

0:00 — The fear that keeps you stuck

2:24 — Why unavailable people feel worth chasing

16:13 — The unconscious contract behind helping

28:38 — The three L's men need

36:48 — Sleeping with someone too early

videos.title: Why You Feel Adrift in Your Life
videos.description: Commitment is a skill you practice. You choose something, accept what that choice costs you, and keep choosing it… even on the days you hate it. Do that long enough and those commitments start stitching your past, present, and future into a coherent story of who you are.
